definition.simple: Organisms that feed on dead and decaying matter, like the mould on old bread.
definition.academic: Any of a group of spore-producing organisms feeding on organic matter, including moulds, yeast, mushrooms, and toadstools.

common_misconceptions: Fungi are a type of plant.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind the student that plants make their own food, but fungi eat dead things.
